purpose: Starter structure for a medicine information database. This file contains no verified medicine records.
important_notice: Do not use placeholder data for medical decisions. Add medicine records only from reliable official sources and include source URLs, country, and last-verified date.

supported_record_fields.strength: Strength as printed on the product label
supported_record_fields.country: Country where this product record applies
supported_record_fields.interactions: Interactions stated by the official source
supported_record_fields.dosage_label: Exact label dosage text; do not convert into personalized advice
supported_record_fields.source_url: Direct URL to the source record
supported_record_fields.last_verified: Date the source record was last checked (YYYY-MM-DD)
